partnershipPlan: Two patient partners with low back pain and two ordering clinicians review the plain-language summary for the board.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I thought the scan would show what was wrong; nobody explained why I did not need one.
items.implication: The specification should include patient explanation material, not only an alert.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If it fires on every order I will click through it without reading.
items.implication: Extract evidence on alert design and override policies.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Tell us what the tool must do and what we will measure after we buy it.
Composite paraphrase: In the emergency department I order the scan because the patient cannot wait weeks for an appointment.

summary: Four composite voices on explanation, alert fatigue, board needs and emergency pressure.
